## What it does
GFP (P42212) is an energy-transfer acceptor that converts aequorin's Ca(2+)-triggered blue chemiluminescence into green fluorescence [UniProt].

## The parts that matter
- 65–67: 5-imidazolinone (Ser-Gly) cross-link forming the chromophore [UniProt].
- 66: (Z)-2,3-didehydrotyrosine [UniProt].
- Mean pLDDT 96.6; the model is confident throughout [AlphaFold DB].

## What goes wrong when it breaks
No disease annotations are present in the dossier [UniProt].
